method.read_as: A proposed public context extension. It is not an independent LLMAJ or consensus result. The authoring agent had project context; only public BOCG definitions are derivation inputs.
method.future_elicitation: Any new consensus claim uses a separately frozen unseeded protocol. These context labels are not examples inserted into the existing SPEC-01 prompt.

domains.label: Institutional finance and capital markets
domains.definition: The shared financial-work context of the public BOCG areas retained across taxonomy generations. Retail banking, household insurance and other unrepresented activities are not asserted to be exhaustively covered.

domains.label: Advisory and origination
domains.definition: Work that advises on, structures or originates corporate transactions and capital raising.

domains.label: Investment management
domains.definition: Work that allocates, manages or executes institutional investment portfolios.

domains.label: Markets and financing
domains.definition: Work that trades, makes markets, structures market products or provides client financing.

domains.label: Operations and servicing
domains.definition: Work that processes, clears, settles, safeguards or services transactions and assets.

domains.label: Risk and control
domains.definition: Work that assesses exposure, values or verifies positions, manages controls or fulfils reporting and conduct obligations.

capabilities.label: Interpret
capabilities.definition: Read evidence, identify relevant facts and distinguish statements from conclusions.

capabilities.label: Analyse
capabilities.definition: Compare alternatives, calculate or explain financial implications under stated assumptions.

capabilities.label: Reconcile
capabilities.definition: Compare records or representations and account for agreement, mismatch and unresolved differences.

capabilities.label: Decide
capabilities.definition: Choose or defer an action using evidence, constraints and authority.

capabilities.label: Authorise
capabilities.definition: Determine or obtain the authority needed for an action; distinguish requests from approval.

capabilities.label: Execute
capabilities.definition: Carry out or specify an operational action and distinguish intention from execution.

capabilities.label: Escalate
capabilities.definition: Route an exception or decision to the appropriate role with the relevant evidence and urgency.

capabilities.label: Verify
capabilities.definition: Inspect evidence for an asserted state or outcome while preserving uncertainty about completion.

capabilities.label: Challenge / falsify
capabilities.definition: Seek or use counter-evidence to challenge a claim, proposed explanation or assumed success.
